title: IndexedDB versionchange Deadlock vs Cooperative Multi-Tab Handoff
description: Step through how an unclosed v3 IndexedDB handle deadlocks a v4 schema upgrade across tabs, and how onversionchange, pagehide, and Web Locks resolve it cleanly.

steps.label: 1. Legacy Tab Holds Open v3 Handle
steps.description: Tab A stays open after deploy running v3 JS with an active IDBDatabase connection and no onversionchange handler.
steps.codeHighlight: const db = await openDb('workspace-db', 3); // no db.onversionchange attached

steps.label: 2. New Tab Requests v4 and Hits onblocked
steps.description: Tab B loads v4 JS (accelerated by skipWaiting) and calls indexedDB.open('workspace-db', 4). Because Tab A ignores versionchange, Tab B fires onblocked and hangs forever.
steps.codeHighlight: const req = indexedDB.open('workspace-db', 4); // hangs in onblocked

steps.label: 3. Cooperative Close on versionchange & pagehide
steps.description: Tab A wires db.onversionchange = () => db.close() and closes handles on pagehide so neither live tabs nor bfcache snapshots hold stale v3 locks.

steps.label: 4. Pure Synchronous DDL Inside upgradeneeded
steps.description: Tab B runs createIndex('byUpdated', 'updatedAt') synchronously inside onupgradeneeded without awaiting fetch(), preventing TransactionInactiveError.

steps.label: 5. Single-Leader Backfill via Web Locks
steps.description: After open() resolves, one tab acquires navigator.locks('workspace-db-seed-v4') to fetch metadata outside IDB and write it in a short readwrite transaction.
